# gramlot-examples 0.3.41 — main and chart galleries

Requires gramlot 0.3.33.

- The hosted sites serve the main gallery at `/gallery/`, a chart gallery at `/chart_gallery/` and, at `/`, a page with one tab per gallery. Old `/pages/...` links redirect to `/gallery/pages/...`.
- The chart gallery holds the chart types family (gauge, funnel, radar, parallel, heatmap, sankey, candlestick, boxplot, treemap, sunburst, and a page on charts that cannot be drawn) and the shares, points, 3D and territories lessons. The Charts family of the main gallery keeps bars, trends and snapshots and links the chart gallery.
- A catalog marked `"common": true` replaces the package catalog, so a gallery can have its own tree.
- The chart types pages use one element per chart type.
